_comment:
Cortex Phase 2 execution pipeline — 6 nodes total.

Phase 2 runs three execution agents (coder, designer, documenter) that
branch from main and make code/design/doc changes. Each agent delegates
writes internally via run_execution_node — no separate write nodes needed
(unlike Phase 1 enrichment agents which update the issue body).

After the three execution agents, code-reviewer diffs each agent's branch
against main and returns extensions.review_status:
  - "clean"      → advance to gate-phase2
  - "needs_work" → retry from coder (max 2 attempts via extensions.review_attempts)
  - attempts ≥ 2 → fallback to gate-phase2 (prevents infinite retry)

The gate node (gate-phase2) uses cortex.dap_steps.human_gate:noop — a
pass-through that does nothing. The actual pause is driven by the engine
via interrupt_before when approval_required_nodes includes 'gate-phase2'.
The operator approves with:
  POST /runs/{id}/nodes/gate-phase2/approve
or simply:
  POST /runs/{id}/resume

Vocabulary note: code_reviewer.py returns review_approved (bool) and
action ("approved"/"needs_work"). The state adapter
(cortex/adapters/pipeline_state.py) translates review_approved=True →
extensions.review_status="clean". This bundle uses the DAP-side
vocabulary ("clean"/"needs_work").

Ref: rafeekpro/dap#164 (interrupt_before + /approve endpoint)

pipeline.name: Cortex Phase 2 — Execution
pipeline.description: Phase 2 pipeline: git-branch → coder → designer → documenter → code-reviewer (conditional retry) → gate-phase2. Execution agents branch from main and make code changes; code-reviewer validates and can retry up to 2 times.

cx_p2_git_branch.name: Cortex Phase 2 — Git Branch
cx_p2_git_branch.prompt_template: <agent_prompt><command>cd {{ extensions.workspace_path }} && git fetch origin && git checkout -B cortex/issue-{{ extensions.issue_number }}/coder origin/main</command></agent_prompt>

install_instructions.summary: Import this bundle into a DAP engine that has cortex-project installed.
steps: 1. Ensure cortex-project is installed in the DAP engine venv: uv add --path /path/to/cortex-project
2. Set CORTEX_ env vars (GH_TOKEN_READ, GH_TOKEN_ISSUES, GH_TOKEN_CODE, GH_TOKEN_MERGE, DATABASE_URL)
3. Strip _comment and install_instructions before importing: POST /pipelines/import with {schema_version, pipeline, bundled_agents}
4. Create a run: POST /runs with pipeline_id and initial_state.extensions={issue_url, issue_number, repo, workspace_path, ...}
5. Phase 2 starts with git-branch (creates working branch), then runs coder → designer → documenter sequentially
6. code-reviewer validates the diff; on 'needs_work' the loop retries from coder (max 2 attempts)
7. When complete (or retries exhausted), run pauses at gate-phase2
install_instructions.gate_design: gate-phase2 uses interrupt_before (approval_required_nodes) NOT a python-func that calls POST /pause. This avoids the infinite pause loop described in rafeekpro/dap#164. The gate-phase2 node itself is a no-op (cortex.dap_steps.human_gate:noop) that executes only after the operator approves.
